messages.content: healthy relationship boundary set korar process ta ki, step by step bolo

Prothome nijer সাথে clear hote hobe tumi ki accept korte parba ar ki na - eta na jene bindaস pura confuse hoye jai bola shomoy. Tarpor sheta partner ke calmly explain koro, blame chara - 'amar eta lagbe' bhabe, 'tumi eta kore bhul korcho' bhabe na. Third step hocche consistent thaka - ekbar boundary bole tumi nijei bhenge felle sheta seriously neya bondho hoye jai. Ar last, respect koro onno der boundary o, eta two-way street, sudhu tomar demand na.
